key.name: email_id
key.description: In some customer environment, users are getting auto created through third party system. So Email Id may be contains any special char in customer end. If we restricted using regex here, that may lead to mail server stopping issue during user creation. So for now, we added character validation in server side for (, @ and .) symbol
